races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Shahbaz
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two turf handicaps this summer after a five-month absence; on a dangerous mark but there are risks attached; blinkers replace cheekpieces today.
runners.comment: Should be well treated but he's been well beaten in two runs this summer; headgear change

runners.name: Star Start
runners.spotlight: Chased home Stellarmasterpiece in this race last year having won a 1m2f amateur riders' handicap at Pontefract 12 days earlier; repeated his win at Pontefract 12 days ago and he should be in the thick of it again.
runners.comment: Second to Stellarmasterpiece in this race last year; Pontefract win 12 days ago; contender

runners.name: Super Hit
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 1m2f last month (good and good to firm); pulled his chance away when third to Mariner at Doncaster 16 days ago; stamina for 1m4f has to be taken on trust but Henry Callan is 5-7 for James Owen and he should give it another good go.
runners.comment: Pulled too hard last time; in fine form beforehand and Henry Callan is 5-7 for the stable

runners.name: Stellarmasterpiece
runners.spotlight: Won three C&D handicaps last year, including the corresponding race (ridden by Becky Smith) off today's mark; comes here on the back of a hat-trick of hurdle wins this summer; high on the list.
runners.comment: Conditions ideal and she won this race last year; in fine form over hurdles this summer

runners.name: Mariner
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the season when winning a 1m2f handicap at Doncaster 16 days ago, suited by the strong pace; 3lb higher mark to contend with and his stamina isn't assured.
runners.comment: Won at Doncaster (1m2f) 16 days ago; that race set up nicely for him; stamina query

runners.name: Austrian Theory
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name since June 2023 and he has found it tough going so far in 2026; he has slipped a long way in the weights though and today's drop in class will help; not discounted.
runners.comment: Hard to win with nowadays but this is a marked drop in class; can't dismiss

runners.name: Spanish Hustle
runners.spotlight: 9lb lower than for his Hamilton win last summer; struggling for form so far this season, however, and others bring more pressing claims.
runners.comment: 9lb lower than for his last win but 2026 campaign yet to get off the ground

races.race_name: Well-Earned Retirement Neal Kidd Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Aura Of Melania
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when third dropped back to 6f at Ripon three weeks ago without suggesting this sharper track would be ideal; she was caught out wide there though and the second has won since so she can't be discounted dropping into a Class 6.
runners.comment: Third at Ripon (6f, good to firm; 2nd won since) three weeks ago; contender down in class

runners.name: Cheeky Chesca
runners.spotlight: Of interest on her best maiden/novice form but well short of that level on her last three starts (in cheekpieces on last two occasions); makes her belated nursery debut and should find this easier; well drawn to attack.
runners.comment: Progress has stalled more recently but she makes her nursery debut & has the inside stall

runners.name: Harry's Pop
runners.spotlight: Better efforts since a gelding operation, fourth in a 6f Southwell novice and a Class 5 nursery at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; drops into a Class 6 and could still have a bigger run in him.
runners.comment: Two solid efforts since a gelding operation; drops in class; still capable of better
runners.owner: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha

runners.name: So Tempting
runners.spotlight: Chased home a subsequent winner when second of six on nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) last month; drawn widest but still a solid contender with further progress possible.
runners.comment: Second of six (winner won again since) on nursery debut latest; can do better

runners.name: Invicta Rose
runners.spotlight: Modest form in five starts, failing to improve for the switch to nurseries at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last month; improvement required.
runners.comment: No improvement for the switch to nurseries last time; needs to raise her game

runners.name: Eevee Star
runners.spotlight: Shaped well on her debut at Ripon (6f, good) in May but that hasn't been a springboard to better things; never dangerous on her nursery debut last month; dropped 2lb and her trainer is banging in the winners.
runners.comment: Not built on a promising debut as yet; still early days and her trainer is in good form

runners.name: Soldier's Echo
runners.spotlight: Some promise on her debut at Bath (5.7f, firm) but no impact in two subsequent runs; this should be more realistic and she is bred to be much better than a Class 6 operator; potential big improver.
runners.comment: Could tap back into debut promise now handicapping at a low level

runners.name: Athos
runners.spotlight: Down the field in three novice/maiden runs at up to 7f; faces a more realistic assignment on this nursery debut; betting to guide.
runners.comment: Down the field in maiden/novice runs at up to 7f; market useful now handicapping

races.race_name: Chapman Milestones Celebration, Thank You NHS Handicap

runners.name: Barmyblade
runners.spotlight: Front-running wins at Thirsk and over C&D last month; only fourth behind Miss Rainbow here 13 days ago but he used up a lot of energy getting to the front from the widest stall; better drawn today and he should have a big run in him.
runners.comment: Had an excuse when 4th over C&D latest; better drawn today; should have a big run in him

runners.name: Miss Rainbow
runners.spotlight: Two wins this summer, the latest over C&D 13 days ago when having a bit to spare; a 4lb higher mark may prove less of a hindrance than the widest stall.
runners.comment: Two wins this summer, the latest over C&D 13 days ago; widest stall not ideal

runners.name: One Of Our Own
runners.spotlight: Ran on well when winning a 6f handicap at Redcar in May; well held at Pontefract last month but that was in Class 5 company; 4lb lower than for her win in this race in 2024; should go well.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2024 off 4lb higher; below par latest but the return to Class 6 is a plus

runners.name: Papa Don't Preach
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; beaten favourite in two 5f handicaps on fast ground this summer but he has still run with credit; stays 6f but still seeking a first win at the trip.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in two 5f handicaps on turf this summer; stays 6f but 0-7 at the trip

runners.name: Edmond Halley
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; two fair runs for his new stable and he can win races off this mark; led last time but that won't be easy in today's field.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; two promising runs for new stable; can win races off this sort of mark

runners.name: Good Karma
runners.spotlight: In good form over 7f, winning at Wolverhampton in June and placed at Carlisle and Catterick since; Ethan Tindall takes off a handy 5lb; drop in trip not ideal but this looks likely to be run at a strong pace.
runners.comment: In good form (7f) this summer & still feasibly weighted; should get a good pace to aim at

runners.name: Jm Jhingree
runners.spotlight: All his wins have come over 5f, the latest at Hamilton in June (good to firm; cheekpieces first time); mixed bag since and although returning to Class 6 company will help, he may prove vulnerable to stronger stayers.
runners.comment: Last run at Class 6 level was a winning one but this trip stretched him in one attempt/

runners.name: Quercus
runners.spotlight: Multiple C&D winner, including this race back in 2021; well drawn to attack but he is yet to fire in 2026; now back in the care of Ann Duffield.
runners.comment: Multiple C&D winner, including this race in 2021; not shone in 2026; back with A Duffield

runners.name: Daytona Lady
runners.spotlight: This mark isn't beyond her but her style of racing doesn't really lend itself to this track; others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: On a competitive mark but she's not threatened in two previous C&D runs
runners.owner: Eric Broadwith And Mrs Ruth Carr

races.race_name: Constant Security Services Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Night Shining
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden; beaten at odds-on at Windsor two weeks ago (tongue tied first time) having made the running; not progressing but she looks to have been found another good opportunity to break her duck.
runners.comment: Not progressing and beaten at odds-on latest; leading contender in this field though

runners.name: Rocktoun Heart
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 5f turf/6f AW winner (RPR 82), half-sister to Argentinian Group 1-placed 1m-1m4f winner Hat Valiente, out of Argentinian 7f Group 1 winner; makes belated debut for a stable not associated with winning newcomers.
runners.comment: Dam a winner from a good Argentine family; yard not known for winning newcomers
runners.owner: Mrs Michele Craig & Miss Linda Perratt

runners.name: Miss Tino
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Intrinsic Bond (5f/6f including AW; RPR 107), Instant Bond (6f including AW; 67), Billy Wedge (6f/7f AW; 66) and Premiership (1m; 64); dam unraced half-sister to 5f-7f winner Sea Salt; stable not known for winning newcomers but pedigree means she's worth a second look.
runners.comment: Half-sister to four winners; starts out in a modest event; market can guide
runners.owner: David Tate, Danny Lawson & Kevin Broadley

runners.name: Star Noir
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in three of his last four starts, including C&D; peak efforts give him a chance but not a compelling option.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in three of last four starts; form claims but not a solid option

runners.name: Top Lad
runners.spotlight: As with stablemate Star Noir he has claims on his best form, namely a 7f third at Musselburgh (soft) last November; two heavy defeats in handicaps this year and drops back to 5f on a recovery mission.
runners.comment: Claims on best form but two heavy defeats in handicaps this year; risky back at 5f

runners.name: Preferred
runners.spotlight: Showed ability but ran to just a modest level in two 6f AW runs in January; hooded for her return to action; not bred to appreciate 5f but this is uncompetitive and she is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Some promise in two 6f AW runs in January; hooded for return; not bred for 5f

races.race_name: racingtv.com Handicap

runners.name: Cheerleader
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D handicap off this mark last May; close third at Ripon three weeks ago but that was a lowly 0-55 handicap; more required in this field.
runners.comment: C&D winner; not beaten far last time but in a 0-55; others appeal more

runners.name: Tees Aggregates
runners.spotlight: Two of his four wins have come over C&D, the latest in June off a 2lb lower mark; come up short in two Class 4 runs since; not discounted back down in grade.
runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner; return to Class 5 in his favour; not ruled out
runners.owner: Ingleby Bloodstock Ltd & The Ivy League

runners.name: Irish Dancer
runners.spotlight: Strong favourite when winning over C&D (good ground) in May; only 1lb higher today but that win came in a 0-55 and this is more demanding; others look stronger
runners.comment: C&D win in May came in a 0-55; some fair form since but opposable for the win

runners.name: Invincible Crown
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark on turf at Musselburgh in June; not so good twice since and he has a double-figure draw to defy this time.
runners.comment: Gained first turf win at Musselburgh in June; less good twice since and drawn wide
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing VIII & Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Canaria Queen
runners.spotlight: She is enjoying a good campaign and today's return to Class 5 company is in her favour; she has run well over C&D in the past and a big run looks on the cards from a handy draw.
runners.comment: Enjoying a good year and the return to Class 5 is in her favour; respected from handy draw

runners.name: Beaumadier
runners.spotlight: Goes well around a left-hand bend; unlikely to have things his own way up front but he has the abiliity to win races off this mark.
runners.comment: Conditions shouldn't faze him but unlikely to get his own way up front this time
runners.owner: R M Brilley, A E Townsend & Partner

runners.name: Staniel Cay
runners.spotlight: Saw off 16 rivals when winning a 5f handicap at Nottingham (good) in decisive fashion in April; soft ground was a valid excuse for a lesser effort at Yarmouth one month later (gelded after); sold for 10,000gns since; still has low mileage and he's of obvious interest against exposed rivals.
runners.comment: Absent since May but his Nottingham win was decisive and he's interesting on stable debut
runners.owner: Jimmy Kay, Tom Goodair And Grant Tuer

runners.name: Emperor's Son
runners.spotlight: Three wins for his former stable, the latest at Hamilton (6f, good) in June; sold for 11,000gns last month; widest stall to overcome on his stable debut; a hood now returns.
runners.comment: Three wins for former yard, the latest in June; sold 11,000gns last month; poor draw today

runners.name: Betweenthesticks
runners.spotlight: Started his campaign with two wins in April and there have been plenty of solid runs since; should remain competitive but minor money perhaps his best hope.
runners.comment: Two wins in April; several solid runs in defeat since; minor money perhaps his best hope
runners.owner: J A Swinburne & Mrs Ruth A Carr

runners.name: Miss Brazen
runners.spotlight: Returned to action with a win at Nottingham (5f, good) in April and she ran a cracker at Beverley one month later; not so good twice since and a lower draw would have been preferred.
runners.comment: Her first two runs of the year were good but her form has dipped twice since; tricky draw

runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Wins his share and he got off the mark for the year over C&D last month; well held at Thirsk three days ago but in a Class 4; this should be more suitable.
runners.comment: C&D win last month; struggled in a Class 4 on Friday; this should be more suitable

races.race_name: Racing Again 26th August Handicap

runners.name: Runninsonofagun
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; galvanised by first-time blinkers when winning at Ayr (1m, good to firm) last month and although he has been expensive to follow since, he has still performed with great credit; the headgear was left off at Ayr last week but returns today; big run expected.
runners.comment: In good form in the last month; well drawn to attack; solid claims with blinkers returned

runners.name: Black Storm
runners.spotlight: Beaten 16 times since a Dundalk maiden win in October 2024; series of good runs this summer, including tried in blinkers at Ayr last week, but he has work to do with Runninsonofagun on that evidence.
runners.comment: Losing run up to 16; running well this summer but behind Runninsonofagun at Ayr last week

runners.name: Vince Le Prince
runners.spotlight: Three C&D wins on his record, including in this race in 2024; near miss over C&D last month and his subsequent Redcar defeat came in a Class 4; big player.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner, including this race in 2024; near miss here last month; solid

runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Six wins this year, including his last four starts; coped well with the return to 5f at Hamilton last month but the return to 7f won't hurt; now moves out of Class 6 company but can't be discounted in current form.
runners.comment: Six wins this year, including his last four; up in class but he can't be discounted

runners.name: Willolarupi
runners.spotlight: 1lb lower than for his last win; never in the hunt at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last month on his return from 284 days on the sidelines; stamina for 7f still to be proven.
runners.comment: Sharper with last month's reappearance behind him but still to prove his stamina for 7f

runners.name: Evocative Spark
runners.spotlight: Three course wins in the first half of the year, the latest (6f, good) off a 3lb lower mark; his form has dipped on his last two starts but a revival wouldn't be a great surprise.
runners.comment: Three course wins already this year; form has dipped on last two starts; revival possible

runners.name: Carolus Magnus
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; made all to win at Musselburgh in June and he followed that with a solid second at Beverley three weeks ago; each-way shout.
runners.comment: Made all at Musselburgh in June and ran well for second latest; each-way shout

runners.name: No Return
runners.spotlight: 0-9 for current stable; dropped 16lb in that time but he is still to convince that he needs this trip; widest draw not ideal either.
runners.comment: 0-9 for Charlie Johnston; dropped 16lb but still to prove he needs this trip

runners.name: Folkene
runners.spotlight: Made a winning British debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 12 months ago off a 1lb lower mark; generally struggled since but her mark is dropping and this is an ease in class.
runners.comment: Not kicked on from her winning British debut last August; drops into a 0-70 today

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Magical Life
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt when justifying support with a runaway win in Kempton nursery (AW; upped to 1m) last Monday; looks well treated under a penalty and has strong claims if she can repeat that form.
runners.comment: Off the mark with a 6l win at Kempton last Monday and she's well treated under a penalty

runners.name: Pequenita
runners.spotlight: First foal of a French 1m-1m3f winner (including Group 2; RPR 111); hasn't really lived up to market expectations in two 7f events (novice/maiden) but it's early days and she's a possible improver now upped to 1m on nursery debut; needs a close look.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who needs a close look upped to 1m on nursery debut

runners.name: Little Mester
runners.spotlight: Has shown promise in three 6f runs, including when a keeping-on third of five in a Brighton maiden (good to firm; 7-2) ten days ago; out of a 1m 2yo winner and he needs watching in market upped to 1m on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Out of a 1m 2yo winner and he needs watching in market upped in trip on nursery debut

runners.name: Poppy Foxy
runners.spotlight: Finished well when winning a Chester seller (7f, good to soft) in June and was only just caught on her nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; up 5lb and she's out of a 1m/1m2f winner and is open to more progress at this new trip; key player.
runners.comment: 7f winner who was only just caught on nursery debut last month; respected upped to 1m

runners.name: Parading
runners.spotlight: Didn't look to enjoy the Brighton experience last month but he bounced back with a close second in a Ffos Las nursery (7.3f, good) 20 days ago; up 2lb but he had to wait for a gap before finishing well last time and he's an interesting contender on this step up to 1m.
runners.comment: Bounced back with close call at Ffos Las (7.4f) and he's respected off only 2lb higher

races.race_name: Singapore Pools Trophy Race Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Itica
runners.spotlight: Has a useful pedigree and he left his debut form behind when going close in a Newcastle novice (1m, AW) last November; didn't match that at Southwell two months later but it's still early days and he's been gelded since; needs a close look back from 209 days off.
runners.comment: Looks interesting on his peak form last winter and he's in the mix on return; been gelded

runners.name: Justice Court
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to Group-placed 6f/7f 2yo winner Gavota; made a promising start when third at Kempton (6f, AW) in December and he reappeared after a gelding operation with a close second on turf here (7f, good to firm; tongue-tie added) 16 days ago; that form puts him firmly in the picture and he's respected on this step up to 1m.
runners.comment: Went close on turf here 16 days ago and he's respected on this step up to 1m

runners.name: Rapide Vega
runners.spotlight: 0-6 for Jessica Harrington and well held in handicaps in his last three runs but he sets the standard on his fifth of 15 in a useful maiden at Gowran Park (1m, soft) in May; comes with risks attached but he's a player if he can get back near his best for new yard.
runners.comment: Inconsistent six-race maiden but he's a player if he can get back near best for new yard

runners.name: Barbuda Bay
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut here (7f, AW) last August but she's not gone on from that and has been well held in both handicaps; still has low mileage but she needs to raise her game back up in trip; blinkers added.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden who has not progressed and needs improvement back up in trip

runners.name: Au Point
runners.spotlight: Mohaather filly; first foal; dam 1m2f turf/1m4f AW winner (RPR 89), half-sister to winners Time And Place (5f 2yo/6f), Belle Travers (7f 2yo/1m2f) and Highland Premiere (6f-1m 2yo), out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: Has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Marchmont
runners.spotlight: £26,000 yearling; gelded half-brother to five winners including Miss Crissy (French Group-placed 1m4f; RPR 108), Serines (1m including Polish 2yo/France; 98) and Eldacar (French 1m4f/1m7f); dam 1m4f winner, half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Serisia; plenty to like on paper and he's an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: Well-bred gelding who is a half-brother to five winners; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Nascondino
runners.spotlight: 23,000euros foal, £30,000 yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners The Big Board (5f-7f including France; RPR 100) and Pignolata (Italian 7.5f 2yo/1m2f); dam 6f/1m (Listed) 2yo winner (101), half-sister to 5f/6f winner Autumn Flight; yard has been firing in winners recently and he needs watching in the market on debut.
runners.comment: Out of a Listed winner and he represents an in-form yard; needs watching in the market

runners.name: Gallant Pioneer
runners.spotlight: Well held at big prices in two AW maidens (7f) this summer and he has plenty to find upped in trip; remains best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well held at big prices in two AW maidens this summer; remains best watched for now

runners.name: Inspectre
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and he finished a remote tenth of 12 on Southwell debut (7f, AW) last month.
runners.comment: 66-1 and he finished a remote tenth of 12 on Southwell debut (7f, AW) last month

runners.name: Lady Blitzle
runners.spotlight: Finished tailed off at a massive price on her recent debut at Kempton (1m, AW).
runners.comment: Finished tailed off at a massive price on her recent debut at Kempton (1m, AW)

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap

runners.name: Fornido
runners.spotlight: Defied this mark at Southwell (1m6f, AW) last autumn and he had a close call over C&D in January; only sixth of seven on recent Yarmouth reappearance but that wasn't a bad effort and he ties in with two of today's rivals on that form; not ruled out back up in trip.
runners.comment: On workable mark and he may have needed his recent reappearance run; not ruled out

runners.name: Belle Of Kt
runners.spotlight: Thriving mare who has won four in a row this summer and hit another personal best with her emphatic success here (1m5f, AW) on Saturday; turns out quickly under a double penalty but she still looks ahead of the game and is unexposed at this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Completed a four-timer with easy win here on Saturday; strong claims under double penalty

runners.name: Star Of Jupiter
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 22 starts was in a classified event at Wolverhampton (9.4f) in February 2025; runner-up over this trip at Catterick (good to firm) 13 days ago but he was beaten 7l and the winner let that form down at Newmarket on Friday night; passed over.
runners.comment: Record of 1-22 and was beaten 7l when runner-up at Catterick last time; others preferred

runners.name: Le Rouge Chinois
runners.spotlight: Rejoined Mick Appleby before reappearing with a good second at Yarmouth (1m6f, good) 12 days ago; has a patchy profile but he's on the same mark as last time and his last win was over nearly 2m in France (AW) in March; respected with Oisin Murphy booked.
runners.comment: Rejoined Mick Appleby before a good second at Yarmouth (1m6f) 12 days ago; respected

runners.name: Regally Blonde
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on her Ripon win (2m, good to firm) last August but she's not made an impact in six runs this season; wasn't far behind Le Rouge Chinois at Yarmouth (1m6f) last time but she needs to find more back up in trip.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but she's not made an impact this season and needs to find more
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

races.race_name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Egotistical
runners.spotlight: Won a Redcar novice (6f, good to firm) in April but she's been disappointing as favourite in two handicaps since; got hampered in a tactical race at Yarmouth in June but she needs improvement after a short break.
runners.comment: Held as favourite in both handicaps and she needs improvement after a short break

runners.name: Tronido
runners.spotlight: Made all for an emphatic win on turf here (7f, good) in May but her form has nosedived at Kempton and Epsom in last two starts; now only 4lb higher than for that last success but she needs a major revival back in trip.
runners.comment: Easy win on turf here (7f) in May but she's lost her way in last two starts

runners.name: Veil Of Clouds
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise in novice events and was a creditable third over 6f on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (tongue-tie added; 2-1 favourite) last month; still has potential after only four starts and she's a key player for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who was a creditable third on handicap debut at Wolverhampton; key player

runners.name: Dark Brunette
runners.spotlight: Mixed results in four starts in Germany but she had a near-miss in a small-field conditions event (6f, good) in May; changed hands for 12,000gns last month and she needs a close look on stable debut.
runners.comment: Ex-German filly; changed hands for 12,000gns and she needs a close look on stable debut

runners.name: Bessie Wallis
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f novice here (AW) last October but she's found things tough in four handicaps since; left David Menuisier for 5,000gns last month; on a reduced mark for new yard but she looked a bit awkward at Leicester (fourth of six) last time and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Won a maiden here last autumn but she's found things tough in handicaps since; new yard

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Pure Passion
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt when justifying support at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; held in second in another classified event here (6f, AW) on Thursday but she was forced wide and that was a creditable effort behind an in-form rival; should have more to offer now switched to a handicap and she's a big player back in trip.
runners.comment: Win and second in classified events in last two starts; big player on handicap debut
runners.owner: J W Parry And Mrs C Shekells

runners.name: Dusk Damsel
runners.spotlight: Promising second on handicap debut here (6f, AW) in April but she's been tailed off in two of her three runs since including at Wolverhampton (7f) last time; that took her record to 0-7 and she has plenty to prove on this drop to 5f; blinkers added.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who was tailed off last time and is untried at this trip; blinkers added
runners.owner: Ms H N Pinniger And Partner

runners.name: Star Marian
runners.spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton maiden (5f, AW) on her reappearance in March but she's struggled back in handicaps since; dropped another 3lb but she's now 1-10 and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Won an AW maiden in March but she's struggled back in handicaps since and is now 1-10

runners.name: Saeculamation
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in December 2025 but that was off 5lb higher in a Polytrack handicap; has been up and down this season but his latest third at Nottingham was behind a progressive subsequent winner; wouldn't want this to be tactical but he's not ruled out back in trip.
runners.comment: Record of 1-19 but he's on a dangerous mark and is not ruled out back in trip

runners.name: Mariselle
runners.spotlight: Ran well to a point on debut here (6f, good) in June but she's struggled in both subsequent runs; still early days but she needs a transformation back at 5f on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Still early days but she needs a transformation back at 5f on her handicap debut

runners.name: Mimime
runners.spotlight: Made debut in May and she's struggled in all four starts including in a 5f handicap at Catterick (last of seven) this month; still unexposed but she needs cheekpieces to make a big difference back on AW.
runners.comment: Still unexposed but she needs cheekpieces to make a big difference back on AW

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: Beta Reader
runners.spotlight: Fair third at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May but he's not easy to predict and was beaten 15l at Epsom last month; now drops back in grade but overall record is 1-20 and he comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Inconsistent 4yo who is 1-20 and was beaten 15l at Epsom last time; risks attached

runners.name: Boston Run
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden who has been well held in six runs for his current yard; continues to drop down the weights but it's been a long time since he's been competitive and others are preferred.
runners.comment: 16-race maiden and it's been a long times since he's been competitive

runners.name: Bergamo Gold
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row on AW in March and the first leg was over C&D; out of sorts in last three runs but the last two have been on turf; on a dangerous mark back in this sphere and one to keep an eye on for in-form yard.
runners.comment: C&D winner who's on a dangerous mark if she can revive back on Polytrack; possibilities

runners.name: Hove Ranger
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo who won a Kempton handicap (7f, AW) in February and was a fair third at Brighton (1m, good to firm) in June; this is a deeper race but he kept on well last time and looks worth another try at this trip; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo who was a fair third at Brighton latest; not ruled out back up in trip

runners.name: Uzincso
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner whose last success was off this mark at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last September; has had some struggles since but he's got back on track with good efforts at Kempton (1m4f/1m3f) in his last two starts; should be unfazed by this drop back in trip and this veteran is a key player.
runners.comment: On last winning mark and he's reached the frame at Kempton in last two starts; key player

runners.name: Twilight Glow
runners.spotlight: Regressive ten-race maiden who has finished down the field in his last five handicaps; now 16lb lower than for his opening mark but he has plenty to prove at this new trip; first-time cheekpieces replace a visor.
runners.comment: Regressive ten-race maiden who has plenty to prove at this new trip

runners.name: Six Blue
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo but she's generally struggled so far and was last of ten on handicap debut at Kempton (1m, AW; 50-1) last month; has plenty to prove and she needs a transformation back up in trip.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo but she's generally struggled so far and has a lot to prove

runners.name: Forca Timao
runners.spotlight: His last win was in April 2025 but that was off 8lb higher at Southwell (1m3f, AW); hit the frame in two starts over C&D this spring and he ran another solid race when fifth of 14 at Kempton (1m) in May; seems tactically versatile and he should be in the mix again after a short break.
runners.comment: Well treated on his old form and was in decent form on Polytrack in the spring; in the mix

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: South Shore
runners.spotlight: Comfortably won over C&D and at Wolverhampton on first two starts for Robert Cowell; back up another 7lb when creditable second at Catterick, which has been followed by a 3lb raise but 3lb-claiming rider is recruited; to win this may demand his best form since early 2024 but he's firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Two wins (one C&D) and a second from his three races for Robert Cowell; firmly in the mix

runners.name: So Smart
runners.spotlight: Dominated a four-runner apprentice handicap at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) last month but not so good there eight days later; back up 4lb today and balance of form this term suggests he is not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Chepstow win two runs ago; balance of 2026 form suggests he is not the percentage call

runners.name: Trust Sergei
runners.spotlight: Back on the scoresheet at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) this June; not nearly so good on either start since, admittedly trying 7f on first occasion but others bring more solid claims; 7lb claimer recruited.
runners.comment: Won over 6f on AW in June but others bring more solid claims; 7lb claimer recruited

runners.name: Kiss And Run
runners.spotlight: 11 races here include one of her three wins; no score since August 2024 and although her two minor honours this year give her a shout, she needs to bounce back from a lesser show when favourite here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: No score since August 2024; two minor honours this year give her a shout; modest latest

runners.name: Bellini Spirit
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden after six races; down the field in her first two handicaps (5f/6f); better when third of six at Yarmouth on latest start, despite it looking as if she did not stay 1m; either way, she still needs better.
runners.comment: Modest maiden after six races; needs better

runners.name: Sunlit Sea
runners.spotlight: 3yo who advanced her form when making all in two 5f handicaps (Lingfield and Thirsk) on fast ground in July on her third and fourth starts this term; good second on Lingfield AW nine days ago; the latter win was under Poppy Scott who is now back on board; drawn to attack from stall 1 and should go well.
runners.comment: 3yo with two wins and a second in her last three starts; should go well from stall 1

runners.name: Thornaby Pearl
runners.spotlight: Usually claimer ridden, to set the pace or race prominently; 8yo who has never raced here but he's been competitive in nearly every race this season, winning three, and went down by just a head and a neck at Newmarket on latest outing; drawn a bit wide but needs major respect.
runners.comment: 8yo; unraced here but competitive in nearly every race this season, winning three

runners.name: Too Darn Good
runners.spotlight: 11th race brought his first win, when making all from stall 5 in 11-runner race over C&D (good to firm; at 11-1) three weeks ago under Taryn Langley; back up 3lb but inconsistency is the chief worry.
runners.comment: 11th race brought his first win, when making all from stall 5 over C&D; inconsistent
runners.owner: K Hunter, D Leon And Hunscote Stud Ltd

runners.name: Muker
runners.spotlight: His last win was off 15lb higher in July 2025; threatened only once from seven starts this term, in a small field three runs ago, and soon got detached on last two outings, so others are readily preferred.
runners.comment: Threatened once from seven starts this term and soon got detached on last two outings

races.race_name: Play The Matchbook Match 6 Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Mithaaly
runners.spotlight: Green and weak in the betting for his C&D debut last month but ran on into second of 12; 8-11 for Yarmouth novice (7f, again good to firm) 15 days later when second of six in a bunched finish, running on late in a steadily run race; while the latter was a bit disappointing, he's still one of the leading players.
runners.comment: Second over C&D (better form) and in steadily run race at Yarmouth (7f; 8-11)

runners.name: Fairy Well
runners.spotlight: 180,000gns yearling; minor honours (6f, good to firm) last month in small fields at Nottingham and Leicester, with probably better form on debut but she is one to take seriously again.
runners.comment: Two minor honours over 6f; probably better form on debut, but one to take seriously again

runners.name: Astralite
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns yearling by Dark Angel; 33-1 for maiden at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month and lost his early position before making late headway into fifth of nine; looks sure to build on that and therefore has each-way claims.
runners.comment: 33-1 for maiden at Ascot (6f, good to firm) and made late headway into fifth of nine

runners.name: Nobelos
runners.spotlight: 110,000euros yearling by Sioux Nation; third foal; brother to 5f/6f 2yo winner Stop The Nation (RPR 90), half-brother to 7.5f/1m winner Sun Soldier (87); dam 6f 2yo winner (92) out of useful 1m winner; from in-form stable.
runners.comment: 110,000euros yearling; brother to 5f/6f 2yo winner Stop The Nation (RPR 90); in-form yard

runners.name: Arthur Carrot
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns foal, 50,000gns yearling, 98,000gns breeze-up 2yo; ninth foal; Perfect Power half-brother to five winners including Nairai (French 9.7f/1m4f), Fedya (French 1m3f) and Star's Of Pride (German 7.5f/1m); dam US 6f 2yo winner; major yard probably has Mithaaly as its first string.
runners.comment: 98,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Perfect Power; major yard probably has Mithaaly as first string

runners.name: Motion Carried
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; Due Diligence half-brother to 5f AW 2yo winner Loleeta (RPR 72); dam 5f 2yo winner (54), half-sister to US 1m Grade 3 winner, out of US Graded-placed 5.5f/6.5f winner; on his debut, others seem more likely.
runners.comment: Due Diligence half-brother to 5f AW 2yo winner Loleeta (RPR 72); dam 5f 2yo winner (54)

runners.name: Lion Of God
runners.spotlight: 75,000gns breeze-up 2yo, bred for further; 33-1, raced too freely and faded into last of six in novice at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in June; should improve but no form claims yet.
runners.comment: 33-1, raced too freely and faded into last of six at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) in June

runners.name: Hemustbeanangel
runners.spotlight: Big odds when showing modest form (6f, good to firm) at Windsor and Salisbury, about 9l third of four in the latter; major work to do.
runners.comment: Big odds when showing modest form (6f, good to firm) at Windsor and Salisbury
runners.owner: James Dellaway And Jon & Kay Collins

runners.name: Best Yet
runners.spotlight: 40-1 when always behind for maiden at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) five weeks ago, so looks a longer-term project.
runners.comment: 40-1 when always behind for maiden at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) five weeks ago

runners.name: Trust Havana
runners.spotlight: Big prices when showing low-level form over 6f on all four starts, latest her nursery debut; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Big prices when showing low-level form over 6f on all four starts, latest on nursery debut

runners.name: Trust In Far
runners.spotlight: Behind at big odds over 6f in all five starts, including a seller.
runners.comment: Behind at big odds over 6f in all five starts, including a seller

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Envision
runners.spotlight: Blinkered last three starts, first with a front-running C&D win; led about 3f when 150-1 in Group 2 at Royal Ascot next time, finishing behind with Magic Effort; a conditions stakes at Glorious Goodwood (again 5f on good to firm) also proved much too strong when a never-dangerous eighth of nine, but she was beaten only just over 4l which seems to augur well for this opening handicap mark.
runners.comment: Goodwood conditions stakes seems to make this mark attractive, although she was 8th of 9

runners.name: Paper View
runners.spotlight: Gelded before his 6f wins last month on good to firm at Nottingham (maiden) and Ripon (nursery); 14-1, fair ninth of 18 when brought out again quickly for nursery at Glorious Goodwood (again 6f on good to firm) but it was a striking performance as he travelled smoothly for a long way; overall improvement is needed but reverting to 5f looks a promising move.
runners.comment: Improvement needed but reverting to 5f looks promising, as he's been travelling smoothly

runners.name: Magic Effort
runners.spotlight: Won a Newmarket maiden in April and not discredited at Goodwood (again 5f on good) in May, before Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm; 125-1) proved far too tough; cheekpieces go on for this far more realistic assignment.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces go on for this far more realistic assignment after a Royal Ascot Group 2

runners.name: Black Velvet Boy
runners.spotlight: Second effort was much better than debut and he made another major advance when making most for a 3l win in 13-runner maiden at Beverley (again 5f on good to firm) three weeks ago, which wasn't in a strong race (despite the second winning next time) but no mean feat seeing as he veered left when leaving his wide stall; fascinating handicap newcomer.
runners.comment: Big improver each time; won at Beverley despite veering left when leaving his wide stall

runners.name: Sky Secret
runners.spotlight: Won maiden at Leicester in May; fifth of 24 in the Super Sprint at Newbury (again 5f on good to firm) was similar form and 6f may have stretched him when 12th of 18 in a nursery at Glorious Goodwood (12-1 from 16-1) which also featured Paper View; the competition in this race is less fierce.
runners.comment: 6f may have stretched him when 12th of 18 in a nursery at Glorious Goodwood (12-1)

races.race_name: #matchbook Loves Racing Handicap

runners.name: Ray Mon Dough
runners.spotlight: Threatened to be useful on occasions even before he won a four-runner handicap at Leicester (6f, good to firm) eight days ago by nearly 5l when tongue tied first time; penalised 6lb in this more competitive race but has to be considered seriously.
runners.comment: Won four-runner race at Leicester (6f) eight days ago by nearly 5l with first tongue-tie

runners.name: Waistcoat
runners.spotlight: Resumed progress when winning by 2l at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on latest start, coming from towards rear; raised another 6lb but earns plenty of respect for his 6f record over the past year.
runners.comment: Raised another 6lb after Newbury win but respected for his 6f record over the past year

runners.name: Righthere Rightnow
runners.spotlight: Won 2yo debut but 0-14 since and his form has been rather mixed; close third off this mark over C&D (good to firm) on penultimate start is the big plus point this year; slowly away when no show over 7f latest; hooded last five starts in 2025 and now tries cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Won debut but 0-14 since and his form has been rather mixed; close third over C&D

runners.name: Under The Twilight
runners.spotlight: Enhanced a good Windsor record when seeing off next-time-out winner Amazonian Dream and ten others over C&D last month; went agonisingly close in a big field at Glorious Goodwood (again 6f on good to firm) 19 days ago and although back up 2lb today, it's not forgotten that she went close in this race last year off 6lb higher still; big shout if she can find the gaps in coming from off the pace.
runners.comment: Good record here and agonisingly close in a big field at Glorious Goodwood last time

runners.name: Lequinto
runners.spotlight: 9yo who's an eight-time Windsor winner, including this May and June; beat Amazonian Dream in the latter race and runner-up to him here next time, before not disgraced on a first crack at Brighton; reliable sort from off the pace and he has each-way claims again.
runners.comment: Eight-time Windsor winner; reliable sort from off the pace and has each-way claims again

runners.name: Cashbox
runners.spotlight: Ended last year with 6f/7f nursery wins; best form was last month when second at Leicester (7f, good to firm; made most in cheekpieces) and fifth of 26 at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm; blinkers); Under The Twilight went past him in the final 1f last time but this 3yo may have more to offer.
runners.comment: Under The Twilight went past him at Glorious Goodwood but this 3yo may have more to offer

runners.name: Buccabay
runners.spotlight: One of his five wins came over C&D in May 2025; third to Amazonian Dream over C&D four weeks ago was an encouraging return from four months off and in-form 5lb claimer is now recruited; in the mix.
runners.comment: C&D third to Amazonian Dream last time was an encouraging return from four months off

runners.name: Tenbob Tommy
runners.spotlight: Started life in bumpers but won at Lingfield (novice) in January and Leicester (handicap) in April on his first two attempts at 6f; creditable third at Brighton (6f, good to firm) ten days ago and he may build on that, as it came after four months off; could have more to offer.
runners.comment: His creditable third ten days ago came after four months off; 2-2 over 6f going into that

runners.name: Amazonian Dream
runners.spotlight: Form dipped slightly when never-dangerous favourite in Class 3 here three weeks ago, following two seconds and a win (all also C&D) on previous three starts; back to Class 4 and, like most of these, has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Running well here before his form dipped slightly last time; e-w claims back in Class 4

races.race_name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Handicap

runners.name: Sisters In The Sky
runners.spotlight: Nine wins in his 91-race career and he was beaten by two noses (by Jackie Brown and Symbol Of Hope) over 5.7f at Bath on latest start, flying at the finish having been last of nine inside the final 1f; that classified race puts him back in the picture but Bath is his most usual hunting ground and his only appearance here was in 2023.
runners.comment: Flew late on when beaten two noses by two of these at Bath, his most usual hunting ground

runners.name: Just King High
runners.spotlight: Sole win (23 races) was an AW maiden in November 2024; way down the weights these days and although he was runner-up twice on AW (7f) in March and showed something here (5f) on penultimate start, others have to be higher up the list.
runners.comment: Sole win (23 races) was an AW maiden in November 2024; way down the weights these days

runners.name: Jackie Brown
runners.spotlight: Experienced ex-Irish mare who was second at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) in July on third start for Adrian Wintle and won by a nose and the same in a nine-runner classified at Bath (5.7f, firm) on latest, leading from Symbol Of Hope on the post and with Sisters In The Sky grabbing third; considered in this handicap, particularly as going back to 6f may well help.
runners.comment: Beat Symbol Of Hope and Sisters In The Sky in finish of noses at Bath, third run for yard

runners.name: Yes Waliim
runners.spotlight: 0-8 before return to form for a narrow front-running win at Lingfield (7f, AW) six days ago; that was an apprentice race, when ridden by Oliver Hoodless, so he can race off same mark today, but there is more to prove on turf form.
runners.comment: Breakthrough win off this mark at Lingfield (7f, AW) six days ago; more to prove on turf

runners.name: Sundiata Keita
runners.spotlight: 0-15, albeit with competitive form off higher marks; easily best show this season was his Chepstow second on penultimate start; tried blinkers latest and now reverts to last season's cheekpieces; his yard won this race last year and a case can be made but others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Reverts to last season's cheekpieces; a case can be made but others are more compelling

runners.name: Symbol Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Pipped by Jackie Brown in a 5.7f classified at Bath last time, with Sisters In The Sky finishing strongly another nose back; that was so nearly his first win for two years (8-81 overall) but coming fourth in 2022 was easily his best result from five visits here.
runners.comment: Split Jackie Brown and Sisters In The Sky in such a tight finish to Bath classified latest

runners.name: Nzuri
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden after eight starts, first five for Jack Channon; started handicap life on a stiff mark (7lb lower today) but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Started handicap life on stiff mark (7lb lower today) but others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in the last three of her four handicaps; visored three times and now tries blinkers.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who failed to beat a rival in last three handicaps; different headgear
runners.owner: M Robinson, S Holden & T Helliwell

runners.name: Geemann
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden whose closest finish was at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) eight days ago when joint-third of eight; needs to build on that.
runners.comment: Closest finish was at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) eight days ago when joint-third of eight

runners.name: Caitlin G
runners.spotlight: With this trainer for last three starts and has found some form, winning by a short head in a six-runner classified at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) 15 days ago; made all and just hung on that day, which gives some encouragement for this return to 6f in a handicap, but further improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Has found some form with new trainer, winning by a short head in 7f classified at Yarmouth

runners.name: Reporter
runners.spotlight: 5f winner here last June for another trainer; has another career-low mark today, having lost his way; third race for current yard.
runners.comment: 5f win here last June for another yard; another career-low mark today, having lost his way

runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.spotlight: Second win (23 races) was a Leicester classified last month; there are plenty of poor runs in his record but he followed that win with a creditable second of seven in handicap at Brighton (again coming from the rear over 6f on good to firm) ten days ago; considered.
runners.comment: Something has clicked again on last two starts, coming from rear for a win and a second
runners.owner: J May, R L Field, W Trenchard, J Pook

races.race_name: Matchbook Handicap

runners.name: Saliko
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Nottingham (1m2f, good/good to soft) last summer; out of sorts this term but this sort of trip (attempted just the twice, ran well once) could be something to clutch at, as well as another career-low mark.
runners.comment: Out of sorts this term; this sort of trip (attempted twice, ran well once) might help

runners.name: Trojan Truth
runners.spotlight: Held up; hat-trick last summer and twice runner-up from five starts this term, short-headed off this mark under Owen Lewis at Ffos Las (1m4f; 33-1) on latest; although not that consistent himself, he looks a lot more solid than most of today's rivals, not least because he's won three times here.
runners.comment: Twice runner-up from five starts this term and he's won three times at this track

runners.name: Highland Harvey
runners.spotlight: Belatedly off the mark in a classified race over the extended 1m3f at Yarmouth (good to firm) in July; better form when third off this mark in a 1m6f handicap there 12 days ago and that gives him a shout.
runners.comment: Off the mark in 11.4f classified; third in a 1m6f handicap 12 days ago gives him a shout

runners.name: Guinness Lad
runners.spotlight: No win in his first 18 starts but he made the breakthrough in a C&D handicap (good to firm; 3lb higher today) in June; fair C&D third seven days later and the disappointing show on latest outing was over 1m2f; case can be made on that winning form and some 2025 efforts.
runners.comment: Breakthrough win came over C&D in June, three starts back; needs a return to that form

runners.name: Pershalla
runners.spotlight: Caused a 40-1 surprise at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in April in a first-time hood (kept since) off 2lb higher than today; ran creditably at Yarmouth (good) next time but below form since, which gives others more appeal.
runners.comment: 40-1 winner at Kempton (1m4f, AW) in April; ran creditably next time but below form since

runners.name: Risk Averse Rebel
runners.spotlight: Modest form on turf and AW, still a maiden after 11 races but his latest defeat was by a nose in a ten-runner handicap at Chester (1m4f, good); placed in five of his eight handicaps and, although he has his quirks with high head carriage, no surprise if he is in serious contention.
runners.comment: Placed in five of eight handicaps, beaten a nose latest; quirky but in serious contention

runners.name: Judge Frank
runners.spotlight: Two wins in September 2024 included one over 1m here; that's from 25 races and he's not done much this season; this trip is a big new move but he has been well held in his three 1m2f races.
runners.comment: He's not done much this season; well held in his three 1m2f races and this trip is new

runners.name: Mister Pretentious
runners.spotlight: Latest start, his sixth, was easily his closest finish but that fourth of six in handicap at Lingfield (back down to 1m2f, good to firm) was still low-level form and he needs much better.
runners.comment: Latest start (1m2f handicap) was easily his closest finish but he still needs much better

runners.name: Mix De Gris
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden (four races on Flat) who was tailed off over hurdles in March 2025 on his final run for Lucinda Russell; that's 504 days off and he has plenty to prove; the hood worn on last six starts is removed.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden (four Flat); tailed off as hurdler in March 2025 on final run for L Russell

races.race_name: Cavani Style & Speed Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Celtic Arrow
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but still unexposed; back on the same mark as when beaten a neck on her handicap debut at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) last month; steps up in trip back on AW and there should be more to come.
runners.comment: Back on the same mark as when beaten a neck on her handicap debut at Thirsk last month.

runners.name: South Coast Star
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when making all over C&D in June when 9lb lower; last of ten at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month but likes it here so must be of interest.
runners.comment: Off the mark when making all over C&D in June off 9lb lower; must be of interest

runners.name: Hamaleel
runners.spotlight: Has ran consistently in defeat since getting off the mark at Kempton (1m, AW) in January; still 5lb higher and probably needs to edge down the weights a shade.
runners.comment: Consistent but still 5lb higher than when getting off the mark at Kempton in January.

runners.name: Ziggy's Queen
runners.spotlight: Has won twice over 6f at this track but has winning form over 7f; hasn't been at her best on turf this summer and needs a resurgence on this return to AW.
runners.comment: Has won twice at this track over 6f; hasn't been doing it on turf this summer.

runners.name: Amelia's Joy
runners.spotlight: Won twice over C&D earlier this year; scored on turf last month (when hood discarded) and may still be on the upgrade; should run well.
runners.comment: Won twice over C&D earlier this year; scored on turf last month.

runners.name: So Sassy
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a career-low mark to register her second win when scoring over C&D last month, doing well to overcome a wide trip; 4lb higher here but should not be far away.
runners.comment: Registered her second win when scoring over C&D last month; up 4lb; not far away

runners.name: Espanita
runners.spotlight: Landed her second win over C&D last month with the aid of a first-time hood (retained); must come under consideration at a track that clearly suits.
runners.comment: Landed her second win over C&D last month with the aid of a first-time hood.

runners.name: Dream Illusion
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on AW, including one over C&D; no obvious excuses for latest 8l defeat at Southwell (1m, AW) though.
runners.comment: All four wins have been on AW, including one over C&D but no obvious excuses latest.

runners.name: Angels' Share
runners.spotlight: Both wins came at Lingfield AW (7f) last year; hasn't been in the same form this term but did better when third over C&D last month and has place claims.
runners.comment: Both wins came at Lingfield AW (7f) last year; hasn't been in the same form this term.

runners.name: Redredrobin
runners.spotlight: All eight wins have been on turf; her mark has been in freefall this year but she showed more in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when second of nine at Brighton (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago; needs to show she can maintain that revival back on AW.
runners.comment: Showed more in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when second at Brighton 12 days ago.

races.race_name: Race And Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Forest Berry
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has been consistent rather than progressive so far, but she has gone close in two of her runs; took a strong hold when a well-held fourth at Doncaster (6.5f, good to firm) last time but a hood is now added and she's a player if she settles at this new trip.
runners.comment: Went close on penultimate run and has claims if she settles at this new trip; hood added

runners.name: Halcon
runners.spotlight: Sister to 6f-1m winner Prairie Falcon (RPR 82); big price on Ripon debut (6f, good) in June, but she came from out the back to finish third behind a 1-3 shot; that form puts her firmly in the picture and she's open to progress upped in trip; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Promising third at a big price on Ripon debut and she's open to progress upped in trip

runners.name: Heavenly Parole
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to Italian 1m/1m1f winner Monte Rasu; dam well beaten 1m1f/9.5f, half-sister to useful winners Vitruvian Man (7f 2yo), Miss You Too (1m2f Listed) and Struth (1m 2yo/1m4f), out of 1m4f winner; drawn out wide on debut and market should guide.
runners.comment: 12,000gns yearling; drawn out wide on debut and market should guide

runners.name: Pon Pon Dalia
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Ziggy's Triton (multiple 5f; RPR 96), Soller Bay (6f-1m1f; 68) and Mullazem (7f/1m); never dangerous when fifth of 12 at Doncaster (6.5f; Forest Berry fourth) this month, but she shaped with promise and should improve for the experience; one to keep an eye on upped in trip.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise on Doncaster debut and she's one to keep an eye on upped in trip

runners.name: Steamy Wonder
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on her debut form when a front-running third in a Lingfield maiden (7f, AW) 13 days ago; that was an encouraging effort, but she got an easy lead in that weak race and the winner was an exposed type; mixed messages.
runners.comment: Encouraging third at Lingfield but she got an easy lead and that was a weak race

runners.name: Eagle Storm
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to useful 7f winner One Night Thunder (RPR 93); finished eighth of 12 on recent Doncaster debut (6.5f, good to firm) but she made some late gains; should know more this time and she's a likely improver on this step up in trip.
runners.comment: Shaped with some promise on Doncaster debut and she's open to progress upped in trip

runners.name: Theft
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros breeze-up 2yo; attracted support into 9-1 at Doncaster (6.5f) 16 days ago, but she never got involved before finishing seventh of 12; finished behind some of today's rivals in that race and she needs a transformation on her second start.
runners.comment: Made a low-key debut at Doncaster and she needs improvement upped in trip

runners.name: Clear Horizon
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field in all four runs, most recently when a fading sixth on nursery debut at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month; has something to find back in a maiden and she's best watched.
runners.comment: Down the field in all four starts and has something to find back in a maiden

runners.name: Velma Dinkley
runners.spotlight: Big prices and she's struggled in a Windsor maiden (6f, good) and a Bath novice (5.6f, firm); remains best watched for now.
runners.comment: Big prices and she's struggled in a Windsor maiden (6f, good) and Bath novice (5.6f, firm)

races.race_name: Cavani Sprint In Style Nursery Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Nascent Star
runners.spotlight: Found the demands of the Super Sprint at Newbury too competitive last month, but shaped with promise when runner-up on his AW/nursery debut at Kempton (6f) 12 days ago; should be right in the firing line.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when runner-up on his AW/nursery debut at Kempton 12 days ago

runners.name: Sable Island
runners.spotlight: Form in five starts has a slightly uneven look to it and she needs to find improvement on this step up in trip; runs without the cheekpieces worn last time.
runners.comment: Form in five starts has a slightly uneven look to it and she needs to find improvement

runners.name: Margaret's Pearl
runners.spotlight: Landed a Pontefract novice (5f, good) on her second start in April; has been flying too high in Listed class since and this nursery debut looks a more suitable assignment; should run well.
runners.comment: Landed a Pontefract novice on her second start in April; held in Listed class since

runners.name: Horndean
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise when making the frame on both turf outings this summer; sports first-time tongue-tie on AW/nursery debut and is another that may find improvement.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise when making the frame on both turf outings this summer

runners.name: Lola
runners.spotlight: Signs of encouragement when making the frame on both starts so far over 5f; needs to show improvement on this step up in trip on her nursery debut, however.
runners.comment: Signs of encouragement when making the frame on both starts so far over 5f

runners.name: Green Titan
runners.spotlight: Improved on his debut run when runner-up at Salisbury (6f, soft) in June; not in the same form when sixth of eight down in trip at Leicester (5f, good to firm) since; has been gelded and steps back up in trip on AW/nursery debut; not out of this.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Salisbury on his second outing but only sixth at Leicester since

runners.name: Wondervision
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when third in a novice at Ascot (5f, good) and in a maiden at Goodwood (6f, good) in May; off since but must be of interest on AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Shaped well when third in a novice at Ascot and in a maiden at Goodwood in May

runners.name: Royal Titan
runners.spotlight: £62,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; doesn't look an imminent winner after his first three efforts but may show more now he tackles his first nursery.
runners.comment: Doesn't look an imminent winner but may show more now he tackles his first nursery

runners.name: Menhaal
runners.spotlight: Has failed to meet expectations thus far but may show more on this AW/nursery debut in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Has failed to meet expectations thus far but may show more on this AW/nursery debut

runners.name: Sydney Grace
runners.spotlight: Built on her debut run to get off the mark at Carlisle (5f, good to soft) in June; the step up in trip should suit on AW/nursery debut and she looks one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Stepped up on her debut run to get off the mark at Carlisle in June

races.race_name: Cavani Sprint In Style Nursery Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Cailin Aine
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the fourth attempt in a Musselburgh maiden (5f, good) in May; needs to find a bit more stepping up in trip on AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at the fourth attempt in a Musselburgh maiden in May

runners.name: Invincible Isaac
runners.spotlight: Back to his best when getting off the mark at the sixth time of asking at Kempton (6f, AW) 12 days ago, beating Nascent Star who is entered in the 6.10; seems to have a liking for AW and may be worth considering off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Back to his best when getting off the mark at Kempton 12 days ago

runners.name: Seed Ya Later
runners.spotlight: Scored at Musselburgh on her second start in April; first home in the disadvantaged far-side group when seventh in the Super Sprint at Newbury (5f, good to firm) last month and should run well here.
runners.comment: First home in the disadvantaged far-side group in the Super Sprint at Newbury last month

runners.name: Angel Ang
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut when scoring at 33-1 over C&D in June; not seen to the same effect in two turf runs since, but may be more at home back here on his nursery debut and has to be of interest.
runners.comment: Made a winning debut when scoring at 33-1 over C&D in June; held on turf twice since

runners.name: Greek Street
runners.spotlight: Has shown just modest form in three runs so far; returns from a break and needs to find improvement on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Has shown just modest form in three runs so far
runners.owner: C Booth, P Boyle, S Coleby & S Smith

runners.name: Unbeatable Fame
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race when third in an Ayr maiden (6f, good) nine days ago; more required on AW/nursery debut, though.
runners.comment: Ran his best race when third in an Ayr maiden nine days ago
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Sea Palace
runners.spotlight: Third on both turf starts in June, his recent effort at Ffos Las (6f, good) a step up from his debut; may well show more improvement on AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Third on both turf starts in June, his recent effort at Ffos Las a step up from his debut

runners.name: Rex Regum
runners.spotlight: Best of three runs over 6f at Windsor when third (good to firm) three weeks ago; may well show more on AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Best of three runs over 6f at Windsor when third three weeks ago

runners.name: Trust Yourself
runners.spotlight: Not fully solid on his turf novice form but appeared to show some improvement last time and a subsequent physical tweak (wind surgery) may prompt another step forward on AW/nursery debut.
runners.comment: Not fully solid on his turf novice form but appeared to show some improvement last time

races.race_name: Follow @AtTheRaces On X Handicap

runners.name: Style King
runners.spotlight: Registered his second win when scoring over C&D last month off 5lb lower; went close to following up when going down by half a length at Lingfield (6f, AW) 13 days ago and may be worth persevering with at present.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D last month; close second at Lingfield since

runners.name: Travel Agent
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D in April off 5lb lower and subsequently followed up at Lingfield; not in the same form since and needs to bounce back to his best.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D in April off 5lb lower and subsequently followed up at Lingfield

runners.name: In The City
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo; in good form without winning in 2025 but has failed to beat a rival in three turf handicaps this term; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces but hard to fancy on AW debut.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in three turf handicaps this term

runners.name: Blue Force
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been over 5f on AW, including one here; hasn't been at his best this year and returns following a break; best watched.
runners.comment: All four wins have been over 5f on AW; hasn't been at his best this year
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner

runners.name: Keldeo
runners.spotlight: Speedy mare but has done all of her winning on turf, albeit she has only had five opportunities on AW; back to her last winning mark but will be vulnerable to late closers.
runners.comment: Speedy mare but has done all of her winning on turf
runners.owner: Ownaracehorse, O Pears and T&T Racing Ltd

runners.name: Dicko The Legend
runners.spotlight: Previous C&D winner but often hindered by starting slowly; sixth of 21 at York (6f, good to firm) last month in first-time cheekpieces (left off here); another win is overdue but he doesn't look ready to strike.
runners.comment: Previous C&D winner but often hindered by starting slowly
runners.owner: Mrs S Hibbert, Foulrice Park Racing Ltd

runners.name: Bill Plumb
runners.spotlight: A dual C&D scorer; not seen since finishing last of six at Yarmouth in April; best watched.
runners.comment: A dual C&D scorer; not seen since finishing last of six at Yarmouth in April

runners.name: Maharajas Express
runners.spotlight: Has three course wins over 5f but has winning form over 6f; hold-up tactics worked to a tee at Chester (5f, good) last month when he weaved through the pack to win by a neck; such tactics do not always pay off so will do well to repeat those here.
runners.comment: Has three course wins over 5f but has winning form over 6f

runners.name: Hectic
runners.spotlight: Just 3-34 but ran better when third of ten at Southwell (6f, AW) 11 days ago; place possibilities.
runners.comment: Just 3-34 but ran better when third at Southwell 11 days ago

runners.name: Tiger Tulip
runners.spotlight: Previous C&D winner but has not fired in three turf runs this year; back on her last winning mark and needs to rediscover her best form.
runners.comment: Previous C&D winner but has not fired in three turf runs this year

races.race_name: Book Hotel And Conferencing At Wolverhampton Classified Stakes

runners.name: Megaphone
runners.spotlight: Last of his two wins in 2025 came over C&D; signs he was on the way back when fifth of 12 here (7f) last month; holds claims in his first classified.
runners.comment: Last of his two wins in 2025 came over C&D

runners.name: Mister McGregor
runners.spotlight: 28-race maiden; second in a similar event over 7f here in June; well held in three handicaps since; opposed on the balance of probability.
runners.comment: 28-race maiden; second in a similar event over 7f here in June

runners.name: Rajeteriat
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's with his third yard; ran poorly back from a break in June and at Brighton ten days ago; has questions to answer in his first classified.
runners.comment: Ran poorly back from a break in June and at Brighton ten days ago

runners.name: Our Hero Matty
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden; after a promising third at Catterick (6f, good to firm) on stable debut in June, he took a backward step when fifth at Beverley (5f, good to firm) and beat only one home in a similar contest at Catterick 13 days ago; first-time blinkers need to have the desired effect.
runners.comment: 13-race maiden; beat only one home in a similar contest at Catterick 13 days ago

runners.name: Jungle Dance
runners.spotlight: Won twice for John Butler in 2024, one of which came over C&D; not been in the same form since and contests his first classified following a break; best watched.
runners.comment: Won twice for John Butler in 2024, one over C&D; not been in the same form since

runners.name: She Went Whoosh
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 37 starts came on the AW at Lingfield (5f) last April; runner-up at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) in May but she's struggled in four starts since; stablemate of Megaphone.
runners.comment: Sole win from 37 starts came on the AW at Lingfield (5f) last April

runners.name: Alafdhal
runners.spotlight: Stable stalwart with 13 wins; not the force of old and contests his first classified; can't discount but likely to find one or two too good.
runners.comment: Stable stalwart with 13 wins; not the force of old and contests his first classified

runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: 1-53 and well held in similar events on turf during the summer; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: 1-53 and well held in similar events on turf during the summer; hard to recommend

runners.name: Let's Go Hugo
runners.spotlight: Three of his four wins have been on AW, including one over C&D; didn't fare too badly in a similar event when fourth of seven at Redcar (5f, good to firm) nine days ago and the return to AW could see him go close.
runners.comment: Three of his four wins have been on AW; the return to AW could see him go close

races.race_name: Follow @AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap

runners.name: James Choice
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden but steadily progressive stepping up in trip, his best effort when runner-up at Southwell (1m3f) three weeks ago with Prince Of Calypso a place back; looks sure to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: His best effort when runner-up at Southwell three weeks ago

runners.name: Optician
runners.spotlight: All five AW wins have been at this track, four of which were over this trip; recorded his first turf success at Doncaster in June and has run well since, which augurs well for this return to AW.
runners.comment: All five AW wins have been at this track, four of which over this trip

runners.name: Prince Of Calypso
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden but showed improvement on his AW/handicap debut up in trip when third of 14 at Southwell (1m3f) three weeks ago; up 2lb with the promise of more to come.
runners.comment: Showed improvement on his AW/handicap debut when third at Southwell three weeks ago

runners.name: Serious Look
runners.spotlight: All four AW wins have been at this track; steps up in distance and holds claims if he gets the trip.
runners.comment: All four AW wins have been at this track; steps up in trip and holds claims

runners.name: Joseph
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on AW at Lingfield over 1m2f; appeared to get the trip when fourth of seven over C&D last month but looks high in the weights.
runners.comment: Appeared to get the trip when fourth over C&D last month

runners.name: Vaguer
runners.spotlight: Formerly trained in Australia where he won 5 races; always behind when last of eight at Southwell (1m3f) on British/AW debut last month and best watched until he shows more.
runners.comment: Always behind when last of eight at Southwell on British/AW debut last month

runners.name: Pure Moon
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on his first two starts; off since disappointing when seventh of eight at Southwell (1m3f, AW) in April; makes handicap debut and may have improvement in him.
runners.comment: Runner-up on his first two starts; off since disappointing at Southwell in April
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Lvii & Mrs G Jarvis

runners.name: Choir Boy
runners.spotlight: Promising fifth on sole start for Aidan O'Brien last October, but below that form for current yard in the winter; steps up in trip on handicap debut with first-time visor replacing cheekpieces; best watched at present.
runners.comment: Fifth on sole start for Aidan O'Brien last October; below that form for current yard

runners.name: Sigliosa
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; sold for 40,000gns to join current yard last October; makes British/AW debut and best watched unless there is a market move.
runners.comment: Makes British/AW debut and best watched unless there is a market move

runners.name: Pace Attack
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in three 1m maidens in the spring; may well come into his own now he steps up in trip in his first handicap; certainly one to keep an eye on in the market.
runners.comment: Unplaced in three 1m maidens in the spring; up in trip in first handicap

runners.name: Thermal
runners.owner: By Talla Racing LLC & John W Sadler Racing Inc
